items.title: What Is CVS Health (CVS) Trying To Achieve With Its Maternal Care Push?
items.summary: CVS Health (NYSE:CVS) unit Aetna has introduced the "Aetna For You & Baby" maternal and infant care initiative. The program targets connecting 90% of Aetna's expecting members and their babies to coordinated care services by 2032. Aetna For You & Baby will use digital engagement tools to help members find, enroll in, and manage end to end support. The Aetna For You & Baby launch only captures part of CVS Health's broader push into integrated maternal and infant services. Check out 1 warning...

items.title: Breakup Plan Could Be A Big Moment For CVS Health Stock (CVS)
items.summary: CVS Health has approved a plan to separate into two independent, publicly traded companies: one focused on healthcare services and the other on retail pharmacy. At the same time, the company released new research findings on GLP 1 medicines that highlight both clinical benefits and access challenges. The breakup plan signals a shift toward more focused operations for CVS Health. This could reshape how investors assess the economics of its insurance, pharmacy and healthcare service activities...

items.title: UnitedHealth sues US government over lowered Medicare Advantage star ratings
items.summary: Nov 20 (Reuters) - UnitedHealth Group sued the US government over its Medicare Advantage star ratings for 2027, saying the ratings threatened imminent harm by depriving the company ‌of bonus payments and lowering benefits for patients. In a complaint filed late on Thursday, ‌UnitedHealth said the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services improperly used 26 measures to calculate ratings for 45 contracts, saying the agency ​lacked statutory authority, did not provide a chance to object, or both.

items.title: Forget UnitedHealth: Humana Has More to Lose From CMS’s Medicare Advantage Audit Crackdown
items.summary: Key TakeawaysUnitedHealth fell 5% on Tuesday after CMS proposed applying Medicare Advantage audit findings to whole contracts, going back to payment year 2018. Humana and CVS Health fell with it, and Humana dropped another 13% on Wednesday.
